## Historical audit: S0251

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_4/audit_sources/raw_failures/scene_rsi_v2_1/r2/fixed_h0/H0/selection/commons_194983350/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file’s JSONL lines and supplied character ranges.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The student was instructed to reconstruct a single indoor RGB photograph with separate meshes, matching viewpoint, framing, placement and materials; no other views or ground-truth calibration were available. The reference image itself is not visible in this audit. The café interpretation is therefore the student’s inferred semantic goal, not independently observed scene content. **[L1, 0–5616; L3, 0–11519]** |
| Actual work | The student returned a complete nonempty SceneAct/Blender program. It specifies many objects: room surfaces, shelving and plants, a sofa and pillows, a table with small objects, several chairs and a planter. These are coded constructions, not verified matches to the photograph. **[L3, 0–11519]** |
| Materials, connections and pose | The program assigns colors, ceiling mottling geometry, common roughness and sheen; labels such as “velvet” and “wood” do not establish realistic textures. Furniture parts are placed using coordinates and separate primitives; there is no demonstrated geometric connection or contact validation. Chair strips and pillow rotations specify intended poses, but their rendered appearance and alignment are unverified. **[L3, 0–11519]** |
| Camera, lighting and validation | The program specifies a 69 mm camera, three area lights, Cycles and a 342 × 512 render. The runner invoked Blender, but execution timed out after approximately 464 seconds; stdout and stderr were empty and the image was null. Thus no visible render, framing assessment, lighting diagnosis or successful build is established. The cause of the timeout is unknown. **[L4, 0–12162; L5, 0–1081]** |
| Exploration and teacher input | One student response and one execution are visible. The recorded student session had zero tool calls; no revision, inspection of a rendering, teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, receipt or adoption appears. A teacher’s availability cannot be inferred from this record. **[L2, 0–2862; L3–L5]** |

**Outcome:** Technical interruption, with reconstruction correctness and formal success unknown—not an empty patch or a demonstrated algorithmic failure. The timeout does not establish whether scene complexity, rendering settings or another cause was responsible. The visible record ends without a successful build or `DONE`. **[L1, 0–5616; L5, 0–1081]**

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, a generated scene specification needs a completed render and visual comparison before geometry, connections, materials or camera can be judged. Task-specific hypotheses—including whether the many primitives or Cycles settings contributed to the timeout, and whether the café layout matches the reference—remain unresolved; neither the reference nor a rendered output is available here.
